title: Research
text: I have seven years experience in electrochemical research with the last five specifically working on water electrolysis. I am most interested in anion exchange membrane (AEM) water electrolysers: an advanced water electrolysis technology that promises to significantly reduce the cost of green hydrogen production. My PhD focused on developing operando diagnostic techniques to better understand degradation in AEM systems.

title: Dr Iain Malone
text: I develop new experimental techniques to reveal how electrochemical devices work and why they fail, advancing the energy transition through research in energy storage and conversion technologies.
